list.name: run_id
list.label: Run
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: "energy", tag: "run_id", predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "energy_raw", start: 2006-01-01T00:00:00Z)

list.name: meter_id
list.label: Meter
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: "energy", tag: "meter_id", predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "energy_raw" and r.run_id == "${run_id}", start: 2006-01-01T00:00:00Z)

options.content: X-axis is **event time** (the UCI timestamp), not wall-clock. Set the time range (top right) to the replayed period, e.g. `2010-01-01` to `2010-02-01`. Prediction, anomaly, drift and model-selection panels are added once the forecasting / detection owners publish their output schemas.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "energy")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "energy_raw" and r.run_id == "${run_id}" and r.meter_id == "${meter_id}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "target")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Missing minutes (range)
panels.description: Minutes whose target reading was '?' in the source (kept as is_missing=true).

targets.query:
from(bucket: "energy")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "energy_raw" and r.run_id == "${run_id}" and r.meter_id == "${meter_id}" and r._field == "is_missing")
  |> toInt()
  |> group()
  |> sum()

from(bucket: "energy")
